movement.manifesto_line_1: The system was not built for us.

movement.vision_text: Turning divergence into leadership leverage to reprogram systems.
movement.mission_text: From awakening young divergent talents to mastering organizational boldness — making divergence the ultimate leadership lever, from school to structure.
movement.what_we_are: A cultural force that brings together divergent experts to transform leadership and reprogram human, organizational and social structures.
movement.vector_propulseur_desc: Action, diagnosis and systemic transformation. The Propeller does not advise — it provokes. It identifies blockage zones, fractures inertia and triggers movement. Its tool: direct confrontation with what is not working.
movement.vector_propulseur_interventions: Shock conferences in corporate and school environments · Decision sprints for entrepreneurs in transition · Crisis coaching for leadership teams under pressure
movement.vector_motivateur_desc: Inspiration, idea collisions and mobilization. The Motivator generates value where conformity has extinguished creativity. It does not motivate people — it shows them what they thought was impossible.
movement.vector_motivateur_interventions: Ideation workshops and employee experience design · Market hacking sessions for startups · Creative sessions with marginalized communities
movement.vector_coach_desc: Identity, NOVA profile and human alignment. The Coach does not tell you what to do — it helps you see who you are when you operate at full power. Psychometrics, archetype, positioning: precision, not therapy.
movement.vector_coach_interventions: NOVA profile for leaders and teams · Positioning coaching for neurodivergent founders · Leader archetype workshops for adolescents
movement.vector_architecte_desc: Structure, knowledge and systems. The Architect designs environments that serve divergence instead of suffocating it. Processes, governance, tools: everything that holds when you're no longer in the room.
movement.vector_architecte_interventions: Friction audits and organizational knowledge architecture · Flexible learning frameworks for educational institutions · Delegation protocols for hyperfocused entrepreneurs
movement.sector_trajectoires_desc: The space dedicated to regenerating the individual and mastering one's own trajectory. We tackle education that homogenizes, families who no longer know how to support difference, life paths that veer off course. Continuous learning, vitality and personal sovereignty.
movement.sector_structures_desc: Intellectual authority applied to the built environment. Organizational architectures, governance systems, corporate cultures that break talent rather than amplify it. We analyze failing structures and rebuild them with rigor.
movement.sector_ecosystemes_desc: An immersion into the human fabric and its institutions. Understanding systemic interactions — health, society, public policy — to navigate the city more effectively. No militancy, no conformity: cold analysis, surgical intervention.
movement.sector_futurs_desc: Technological leverage in service of the unknown. Exploration of AI, technological disruptions and strategic anticipation. We code tomorrow's competitive edge while others are still debating whether change is useful.

karim-mansour.name: Karim Mansour
karim-mansour.signature: I don't arrive with recommendations. I arrive with the decision you haven't been brave enough to make yet.
karim-mansour.bio: Karim spent twelve years diagnosing organizations in crisis — not to reassure them, but to force them to see what they were avoiding. A former transformation director at two multinationals, he built his independent practice after realizing that conventional consultants sell analysis where what's needed is courage. His mandates rarely last more than 90 days. Their effects, much longer.
karim-mansour.intervention_1: Decision sprints for leadership teams in blockage
karim-mansour.intervention_3: Crisis coaching for CEOs under strategic pressure

nadia-tremblay.name: Nadia Tremblay
nadia-tremblay.signature: You don't realign by reading a book. You realign when someone actually sees you.
nadia-tremblay.bio: Nadia is a psychometrician and coach specializing in atypical profiles — ADHD, ASD, giftedness, hypersensitivity. What sets her apart: she doesn't try to adapt her clients to the system. She helps them build the system that fits them. A certified NOVA profile practitioner, she works with founders, managers in transition and high-potential adolescents looking for their anchor.
nadia-tremblay.intervention_1: NOVA profile for leaders and teams

olivier-brisson.name: Olivier Brisson
olivier-brisson.signature: An organization that can't function without you isn't an organization. It's a dependency.
olivier-brisson.bio: Olivier builds systems. Processes, delegation, governance, knowledge architecture — he constructs what holds when you're no longer in the room. An engineer by training, he shifted to organizational architecture after realizing that the most complex human problems often have a structural solution. He works primarily with hypergrowth startups and tech teams that are burning out.
olivier-brisson.intervention_1: Friction audits and organizational knowledge architecture

sonia-leblanc.name: Sonia Leblanc
sonia-leblanc.signature: Creativity isn't managed. It's liberated. My work is removing what smothers it.
sonia-leblanc.bio: Sonia works at the intersection of work psychology and experience design. She intervenes in organizations that have lost the fire — teams going in circles, cultures that have calcified, leaders confusing conformity with stability. Her workshops are uncomfortable. Her results, measurable. She is particularly active in education and health sectors.
sonia-leblanc.intervention_1: Ideation workshops and employee experience redesign
sonia-leblanc.intervention_2: Creative hacking sessions for stagnating teams
sonia-leblanc.intervention_3: Support for school administrations in cultural transformation

marco-pietri.name: Marco Pietri
marco-pietri.signature: AI won't replace leaders. It will expose those who were never really leading.
marco-pietri.bio: Marco operates at the frontier of business strategy and digital transformation. He advises executives on integrating AI into their decision-making processes — not as a technology gadget, but as an organizational power lever. A former product director at three tech startups, he knows the difference between tools that change everything and tools that impress in demos. His mandates are short, dense and results-oriented.
marco-pietri.intervention_1: AI integration diagnostics for boards and executive teams
marco-pietri.intervention_2: Digital transformation sprints for SMEs in transition
marco-pietri.intervention_3: Strategy conferences on technology for non-technical audiences

yasmine-harrak.name: Yasmine Harrak
yasmine-harrak.signature: Social policies don't change systems. They describe their limits. I work outside those limits.
yasmine-harrak.bio: Yasmine intervenes at the intersection of public policy, collective mental health and community organizations. She designs frameworks for action that work where institutional approaches have failed — not despite constraints, but by integrating them. Her approach is pragmatic, documented and resolutely non-activist. She works with institutions, foundations and nonprofits that want measurable impact, not moral positioning.
yasmine-harrak.intervention_1: Architecture of high-impact social intervention programs
yasmine-harrak.intervention_2: Governance frameworks for mission-driven organizations in constrained environments
yasmine-harrak.intervention_3: Systemic diagnostics for foundations and philanthropic funds

memberships.hero_subtitle: Four spaces. One architecture. The Signal, The Forge, The Field — in every space, the same triptyque, calibrated for your reality.

memberships.releve_eveil: News and analysis on education, entrepreneurship and the identity of young atypical leaders. Pure signal, without algorithmic noise.
memberships.releve_forge: Self-management tools, work methods and resources to turn your difference into an engine. No theory — protocols.
memberships.releve_chantier: Events, meetups and active projects to break isolation and discover divergent success models.
memberships.xminds_target: Neurodivergent individuals (ADHD, ASD, giftedness) or those who feel in permanent misalignment with the systems around them.
memberships.xminds_hook: You're not dysfunctional. The system is. X-Minds is the space to stop enduring and start capitalizing on who you actually are.
memberships.xminds_eveil: Intelligence on mental health, neurodivergence and the social phenomena that keep atypical profiles trapped in misaligned structures.
memberships.xminds_forge: NOVA profile, psychometrics and strategies to turn your cognitive operating mode into a competitive advantage at work and in life.
memberships.xminds_chantier: Discussion circles, D&L events and active projects with other members and Rogues from La Cellule.
memberships.leaders_target: Managers, executives and entrepreneurs who lead differently — or who want to without losing their position.
memberships.leaders_hook: Compliant leadership produces compliant organizations. If you're reading this, you've already understood that compliance is no longer enough. Divergent Leaders is the space to act on that.
memberships.leaders_eveil: Intelligence on divergent leadership, new management architectures and the failures of conventional organizational models.
memberships.leaders_forge: Alternative management methodologies, decision-under-pressure training and access to protocols developed by Rogues of La Cellule.
memberships.leaders_chantier: Guild-style events with Rogues, live case studies and open mandates for observation.
memberships.orgs_target: School administrations, HR teams, startup founders, diverse organizations, boards of directors in transition.
memberships.orgs_hook: Your organizational culture is either a talent amplifier or a filter that eliminates your best profiles. Divergent Organizations gives you access to the tools and experts to shift from one side to the other.
memberships.orgs_eveil: Intelligence on organizational transformation, disruptive HR policies and business models that turn divergence into a structural advantage.
memberships.orgs_forge: Template internal policies, simplified friction audits and organizational architecture protocols developed by La Cellule Architects.
memberships.orgs_chantier: Direct channel to mandate or consult Rogue experts, active transformation project tracking and access to measurable results.

struc-01.title: Divergent Governance
struc-01.format: Three video modules (90-minute masterclasses each). White Paper: Architecture of Power — A Practical Guide to Divergent Governance. Diagnostic tools applicable immediately.
struc-01.promise: Live tracking of the Divergent Governance pilot project in two partner organizations. Results, obstacles, adjustments: in real time, unfiltered.
struc-01.eveil: Corporate decision-making systems were designed for stability, not speed. In an environment of permanent disruption, they produce inertia dressed up as prudence.
struc-01.forge: After this dossier, you can diagnose a failing governance system, identify the real decision levers (as opposed to the official ones) and put in place a decision architecture that holds under pressure.
struc-01.chantier: Real case studies of failing governance. Deconstruction of the mechanisms that turn competent organizations into paralyzed ones. In-depth articles on decision-making in disruption contexts.

traj-02.title: Educational Sovereignty
traj-02.format: Two video modules. Summary PDF: The Educational Awakening Protocol. Intervention sheets for teachers, parents and school administrations.
traj-02.promise: Trajectories project tracking — a roundtable led by ROGUE with school practitioners and families of atypical profiles. Full documentation of progress and resistance.
traj-02.eveil: Schools homogenize. They produce compliant workers in a world that needs divergent thinkers. Atypical profiles — ADHD, ASD, giftedness — learn to simulate normality rather than capitalize on their difference.
traj-02.forge: You understand the mechanisms of school exclusion and know how to intervene — whether you are a parent, teacher, principal or decision-maker. You have an action protocol applicable within 30 days.
traj-02.chantier: Intelligence on global education reforms, alternative models that work and data on the school disengagement of atypical profiles. Pure signal, without ideological agenda.

eco-01.title: School Fragmentation
eco-01.format: Main video module (2h). White Paper: Mapping Systemic Fractures. Methodological framework for inter-institutional interventions.
eco-01.promise: Project Alpha: Alternative Health — a solutions lab for inter-service coordination in three regions. Impact dashboards, field interviews, preliminary results.
eco-01.eveil: Mental health institutions, community organizations and social support systems operate in hermetic silos. Result: the most vulnerable people fall through the gaps between services.
eco-01.forge: You have a map of the systemic fractures in the service continuum. You identify high-leverage intervention points and have an action framework for operating in constrained institutional environments.
eco-01.chantier: Analysis of failures in mental health and social support systems. International case studies on service integration. Deconstruction of the bureaucratic mechanisms that perpetuate fragmentation.

futu-01.title: Tech Protocol · AI Lever Calibration
futu-01.format: Two video modules (masterclasses). White Paper: AI Lever Calibration — Strategic Guide for Leaders. AI tool evaluation framework applicable to any sector.
futu-01.promise: Tech Protocol in progress: deployment of an AI decision support system in two partner organizations. Impact metrics, adoption obstacles, lessons learned documented in real time.
futu-01.eveil: AI is presented either as an existential threat or a magic tool. Both readings are forms of avoidance. The reality: it is an organizational power lever — for those who know how to seize it before others.
futu-01.forge: You have a strategic framework for integrating AI into your decision-making processes — without hype, without fear, with concrete evaluation criteria. You know how to distinguish transformative tools from expensive gadgets.
futu-01.chantier: Intelligence on real AI advances applied to governance, decision-making and organizational architecture. Deconstruction of fear and euphoria narratives. Calibrated signal for decision-makers.

faq.q1: What is the difference between X-Minds and Divergent Leaders?
faq.a1: X-Minds is for individuals who want to understand and master their own cognitive functioning — often neurodivergent profiles seeking alignment. Divergent Leaders is for those who already hold a leadership position and want to exercise it differently. The two spaces can complement each other, but they address distinct needs.
faq.q2: Can I access more than one space at the same time?
faq.a2: Yes. Each space is an independent subscription. If you are both an atypical manager and someone who wants to better understand their neurodivergence, X-Minds and Divergent Leaders can coexist.
faq.q3: What exactly is a Rogue File?
faq.a3: A Rogue File is a complete expert dossier on a specific systemic failure. It contains three sections: The Signal (intelligence and analysis), The Forge (courses, protocols and tools), and The Field (active projects and measurable results). Each dossier is produced by Rogues of La Cellule and updated as mandates progress.
faq.q4: Are Rogue Files included in the membership?
faq.a4: Yes. A membership subscription gives access to Rogue Files corresponding to that space, at reduced or included pricing depending on the plan. Rogue Files can also be purchased individually in the Boutique, at full price for non-members.
faq.a5: Groupe ROGUE does not host public forums or comment sections. Individual progression, collective impact. This is a structural decision — not a technical limitation. It guarantees the quality and confidentiality of the learning environment.
faq.a6: Cancellation is free, with no fees, directly from your Stripe customer portal. Your access remains active until the end of the period already paid. No questions asked, no forced retention.
faq.a7: Yes. La Relève is the entry space into the ecosystem — accessible without a paid subscription. It gives access to the Youth Codex, some Forge content and Field events. It is our commitment to the next generation of divergent leaders.
faq.a8: The NOVA profile is a psychometric tool used by Rogue Coaches to identify the cognitive operating mode, leadership styles and alignment zones of an individual. It is available in the X-Minds space and on request in the context of Divergent Leaders mandates.
faq.q9: How do I contact a Rogue directly?
faq.a9: From the /rogues page, each agent profile contains a "Book an intervention" button. For organizational inquiries, the /contact page offers a dedicated form for corporate mandates with routing to the right vector and sector.
faq.q10: Does Groupe ROGUE operate outside Québec?
faq.a10: The base is in Montreal, but several Rogues intervene remotely or on location across Canada and in French-speaking Europe. Rogue Files are accessible worldwide. Phase 3 development includes a structured expansion outside Québec.
